text:
maria (support): FYI customer reported Node edge streaming issue — their ReadableStream closes early after a token rotate and they see duplicate billing events + intermittent 401s. attaching initial logs below.
sam (eng): can you paste the minimal repro and SDK version? edge vs node? runtime?

maria (support): running in Vercel Edge (edge runtime), using @redwood/inference-js v0.8.1. repro steps from customer:
1) start SSE stream to /v1/chat/completions via fetch in edge function
2) after ~7-10s they rotate auth token (server-side)
3) stream gets a close event on client, and server shows duplicate request counts (billing spike)

logs:
```
2025-12-03T13:04:12.123Z request id=abc123 method=POST /v1/chat/completions 200 0.45s
2025-12-03T13:04:19.876Z token rotated for user=acct-90
2025-12-03T13:04:20.002Z request id=abc124 method=POST /v1/chat/completions 401 0.01s
2025-12-03T13:04:20.005Z retry webhook triggered for request id=abc124
```

maria (support): customer code simplified (edge runtime):
```js
export default async function (req) {
  const r = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` },
    body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'rw-large', prompt: 'hi' })
  });
  const reader = r.body.getReader();
  // read loop
}
```

jen (cs): they say it worked when pinned to v0.7.x. only started with v0.8.1 after we shipped the new auto-retry patch.

taylor (eng-runtime): hypothesis: auto-retry in SDK triggers a second request when fetch returns non-200 while stream was still open. In edge runtimes, getReader() + fetch can produce a closed stream if headers change (auth) mid-flight. Also possible the SDK's retry increments request count before original response is fully drained -> billing double-count.

sam (eng): do we have instrumentation showing whether the second request is initiated by the SDK or by the platform retry? Could be the customer's infra rotating token and a small window where the SDK sees 401 and retries.

maria (support): customer attached HAR showing two POSTs within 8ms of the 401. they also note SSE events cut off at the client side right after rotate.

taylor (eng-runtime): quick checks:
- confirm SDK v0.8.* introduced automatic retry on 401/5xx for streaming (I think it now retries by default)
- ensure retries don't re-issue while original response body is still being consumed
- for edge runtimes we should prefer re-establishing stream vs retries to avoid duplicate billing

sam (eng): can you reproduce locally in an edge-like environment? I can try with a tiny edge worker in Cloudflare pages or Vercel dev. assign me.

maria (support): customer gave permission to repro on their tenant. they prefer we test on a canary before recommending pin.

support-bot: <incident created: INC-2025-481> linked to ticket #C-4982

jen (cs): customer impact: high (production), billing noise, UX broken. they want either a fix or an official mitigation.

taylor (eng-runtime): mitigation options:
- short-term: recommend pin to 0.7.x and disable autoRetry in SDK config
- mid-term: change SDK so streaming retries are opt-in and ensure original stream is drained/aborted before starting a retry; add a guard to not double-bill for same client request id
- long-term: add server-side idempotency or billing dedupe for short windows on streams

sam (eng): I'll spin up a Vercel edge function that rotates token mid-stream and run test harness. maria, can you add the customer's token and permission in the repro doc?

maria (support): added token + repro notes to ticket. gist link: https://gist.github.com/xxxx/small-repro

jen (cs): customer tried pinning to 0.7 and confirmed streaming remained stable for 30m. they want firm ETA.

taylor (eng-runtime): provisional plan:
- PR to SDK to make streaming retries opt-in + immediate patch to disable default retry for SSE (target: next minor, 0.8.2)
- internal follow-up for billing dedupe (billing team) to avoid double-charging within 1s for same client request id

sam (eng): repro status: I can reproduce the early close + duplicate POST locally. root cause: SDK's fetch wrapper triggers a retry on 401 without aborting reader, and our retry path issues a fresh fetch that the edge platform treats as a new request (billing).

maria (support): customer updated: pin to 0.7 worked; they asked for recommended config in the meantime.

taylor (eng-runtime): temp mitigation message for support to send:
"We're seeing this happen if you use SDK v0.8.x with default auto-retry in edge runtimes. Please pin to @redwood/inference-js@0.7.x or set autoRetry: false in your SDK client config until we ship a patch. We'll follow up with a fix in a minor release and a billing dedupe on our side."

sam (eng): created PR branch edge/retry-stream-guard with initial fix to abort reader before retry and add config flag `streamingRetries: false` by default. linking: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/sdk/pulls/234

jen (cs): will send customer the mitigation + PR ETA (ETA: 48h for patch rollout) and ask if they'd like us to apply the pin on their canary tenant.

maria (support): customer requested we apply the pin to their canary. assigned to sam.

support-bot: <deploy queued: sdk-edge/retry-guard v0.8.2-canary>

sam (eng): applying pin to customer's canary now. will monitor for billing noise.

maria (support): thanks all, I'll update the ticket and close loop once customer's canary is stable. :thumbsup:

jen (cs): follow-up TODOs:
- maria: update ticket with mitigation text and canary progress
- sam: finish PR + canary deploy + monitor metrics
- taylor: follow up with billing for dedupe window

maria (support): noted. closing internal thread when canary stable."
